d: Настала пора решающих матчей Лиги наций: до конца групповой стадии командам осталось провести по два матча. Впереди борьба за выход в четвертьфинал и повышение в классе.

de: It is time for the decisive matches of the Nations League: until the end of the group stage, the teams have two matches left. Ahead of the fight for reaching the quarterfinals and promotion in the class.

d: Банки и другие финансовые организации начнут со следующего года встраивать "позитивные наджи" в свои продукты. Разработкой и внедрением таких элементов, которые формируют рациональное финансовое поведение, будет заниматься Ассоциация…

de: The traffic police called the preliminary cause of the accident in the Republic of Mari El, where in a collision of two vehicles killed seven people, several others were injured.

de: The mass mailing of bomb-threatening emails has caused serious alarm across Italy, disrupted the educational process and forced law enforcement to conduct extensive inspections at hundreds of educational institutions. Authorities say…

de: The official representative of the Russian foreign Ministry Maria Zakharova commented on the hostile attitude of the language Ombudsman of Ukraine Elena Ivanovskaya to the Russian speech, recalling a phrase from the Soviet film “Mimino”.

de: The bodies of the elderly couple, found in the freezer in Rostov-on-Don, could be there for a month and a half. About this RIA Novosti told in law enforcement agencies.

de: A tanker with fuel on board sank in the Gulf of Thailand off the coast of the Thai province of Chonburi. Six people are missing, according to The Nation newspaper.

de: Doctors of two medical institutions of Primorsky Krai saved the hand of a child who was attacked by dogs. The boy received a large laceration wound, he also had a damaged brachial artery, according to the Max-channel of the Ministry of Health of the region.

de: The threat of an attack by unmanned aerial vehicles was canceled in the Novosibirsk region. This was informed by the Unified State System for Prevention and Elimination of Emergency Situations (RSES).
